recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not infer URI registration, binding, or replacement work from this DSTU2 ballot item; handle those questions only under FHIR-51533 or another final OO/terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11106 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking how a sender or receiver can know UDI jurisdiction from the carrier string and requesting that Device UDI guidance convey both the jurisdiction/repository authority and assigning authority.
initial_application: No current-history commit names FHIR-11106 exactly, but commit 2bd8c95642d3c1f3609ca70c5b6678a874b8de35 explicitly covered the [#11105]-[#11109] Device UDI tracker family plus #11049/#11050 and changed UDI examples to the separated UDI backbone shape with jurisdiction, issuer, carrierHRF/carrierAIDC, and entryType fields.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini and source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml is the authoritative current Device definition. Current source defines Device.udiCarrier.jurisdiction as the authoritative jurisdictional UDI source/repository and Device.udiCarrier.issuer as the UDI issuing organization. Later Published issues FHIR-32553 and FHIR-35973 refined URI examples and issuer cardinality and are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-51533 and Zulip discussions identify unresolved THO/NamingSystem registration concerns, but FHIR-51533 is still Waiting for Input.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build already provides the requested semantic separation through Device.udiCarrier.jurisdiction and Device.udiCarrier.issuer, with UDI examples showing those values populated separately from the carrier string.

related_jiras.note: The seed resolution points to the shared UDI presentation attached there, and the 2017 application commit handled #11105-#11109 together.
The AIDC support issue was applied in the same 2017 Device UDI tracker family but concerns carrier encoding rather than jurisdiction inference.
Later Published issue refined Device.udiCarrier issuer and jurisdiction URI examples and is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published issue changed Device.udiCarrier.issuer cardinality and is already represented on the combined branch.
Unresolved Waiting for Input issue about UDI URI values not being defined in THO; not final enough for this reconciliation.
